name: web
description: Fetch a known URL via the local backend. Search is injected server-side on DeepSeek.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch readable text of a known http(s) URL via the local backend. Use after web_search finds a link, or when the user gave a URL. If fetch errors (Amazon often 403), do not invent prices/ASINs — mark 未能获取 and fall back to web_search snippets.
